title: FanDuel parent Flutter says CEO Peter Jackson is stepping down, replaced by President Dan Taylor, and reports a lower profit outlook as its US business falters (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: FanDuel parent Flutter says CEO Peter Jackson is stepping down, replaced by President Dan Taylor, and reports a lower profit outlook as its US business falters — The parent company of FanDuel says CEO Peter Jackson is being replaced by Dan Taylor, the company's president
